name: many-campaigns
about: Four campaigns, figures in the thousands, one with no lead.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 4 campaigns delivered 67 leads across 161,223 impressions at a combined cost per lead of $38.51.
points: Total spend for the day was $2,580.48, with 2,323 clicks at a click rate of 1.4%; month-to-date spend on Meta stands at $12,534.06 with 28 days left in 2026-11.
Regional Class A — Joliet was the largest campaign: $1,456.78 spent, 92,400 impressions, 1,310 clicks, 41 leads, cost per lead $35.53, click rate 1.4%.
Recent graduates was the strongest performer on click rate at 1.7%, producing 17 leads at $35.89 each from $610.20 spent across 40,118 impressions.
Dedicated night runs spent $389.00 for 9 leads at $43.22 per lead, the highest cost per lead of the day, with a click rate of 1.2% across 21,005 impressions.
Owner operators drew no leads from $124.50 spent across 7,700 impressions and 51 clicks at a 0.7% click rate, so there is no cost per lead to report.

The 2026-10-26 cohort (12 leads, 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, 1 lost after conversion, 0 hired) is too young to judge; note that qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
